values.note: recreation.gov 2026 rate table: $10/night for every site in the reservable Peak Season (May 22 - Sep 6); free in the first-come, first-served seasons (Apr 1 - May 21 and Sep 7 - Nov 30: 'Sites are free and first-come-first serve').

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10386530 ('7 standard non-electric campsites') + recreation.gov catalog (7 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, water/sewer hookups 'No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 7 standard non-electric sites; equipment allowed includes RV, fifth wheel, trailer and pickup camper; no maximum vehicle length published. Site limits: 2 motorized vehicles, 1 camping unit and 2 tents (or 3 tents), 8 people.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10386530 ('7 standard non-electric campsites'; notice 'Site Limits: 2 motorized vehicles 1 Camping unit (RV, motorhome, camper, van, etc) and 2 tents or 3 tents 8 people') + recreation.gov catalog (7 sites, equipment RV/Fifth Wheel/Caravan/Pickup Camper, Max Vehicle Length blank), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Picnic tables, fire rings, a vault toilet, trash collection and a boat ramp (recreation.gov's amenity list does not mention drinking water).

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10386530 ('Amenities include picnic tables, fire rings, a vault toilet, and boat ramp'; amenities 'Boat Ramp', 'Fire Pit', 'Picnic Tables', 'Trash Collection', 'Vault Toilets'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run by the Corps itself (USACE, not a concession). Peak season (2026: May 22 - Sep 6) is reservation only on recreation.gov with no first-come sites; the spring and fall seasons are free and first-come, first-served. 14 nights total within a rolling 30 days across the Libby Dam project (Alexander, Dunn Creek, Blackwell and Downstream).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10386530 (org USACE, is_commercially_managed false; notice 'Campsite during "Peak Season" are reservation only. There are no First Come, First Serve sites. First Come, First Serve sites are only available during "Non-Peak Season"', 'You may stay up to 14 nights total at the Libby Dam project (Alexander, Dunn Creek, Blackwell and Downstream (non-reservation)) within rolling 30 days') + /rates, read 2026-10-22

note: Small Corps of Engineers campground on the west bank of the Kootenai River about 3.5 miles below Libby Dam, ~20 mi from Libby. Large, level gravel sites, some pull-through; a reviewer fit a 24-ft Class B. Train noise across the river; no cell service. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov record and rate table: confirmed 7 non-electric sites, no hookups, vault toilet, reservable on recreation.gov. Changed fees 0/0 -> 0/10 ($10 peak, free in the FCFS shoulder seasons; the old value read only the current FCFS season). Added season 04-01 to 11-30 (closed Dec 1 - Mar 31), 14-night limit (rolling 30 days, project-wide), peak reservation-only / off-peak FCFS in booking note, site limits. Not stated: drinking water (derived potable_water left; rec.gov amenities don't list it), max rig length, pull-through. Note trimmed of restated fields.
